theme_central: Curse upon Abu Lahab, fierce opponent of the Prophet: neither his fortune nor his rank will save him from the Fire, nor will his complicit wife.
sources_note: Universally known content, no possible divergence.

branches.title: Curse upon Abu Lahab
branches.resume: May the two hands of Abu Lahab perish; his fortune will be of no use to him.

children.t: Curse upon Abu Lahab, his fortune useless

branches.title: Punishment, his complicit wife
branches.resume: He will burn in a flaming Fire, as will his wife, the carrier of firewood.

children.t: Punishment of the Fire for Abu Lahab and his complicit wife
